TUT1_1: Welcome to Combat Monsters, a game about killing things with stuff. Tap anywhere to continue.
TUT1_2: This is your Hero. There are many to choose from, but for now you'll be using Doc Pain.
TUT1_3: And this is the enemy Hero - me! You win battles by killing all the opposing enemy Heroes.
TUT1_4: And if your Hero dies, well... I'm sure you can figure out what that means.
TUT1_5: Tap on your Hero now to select him.
TUT1_6: Your Hero can move and attack once per turn. Move him forward by tapping the circle with the arrow inside.
TUT1_7: He is now in range of the enemy Hero. Select your Hero and then Tap on the enemy to attack.
TUT1_8: Ouch! You may have noticed the little numbers under the Heroes.
TUT1_9: The Red symbol is Power - this is how much damage your attacks deal.
TUT1_10: The Green symbol is Health. You may have noticed I started with 6, and now have 5.
TUT1_11: This is a turn-based game, so let's end the turn to progress.
TUT1_12: Destroying the enemy Hero wins the game. Come get me!
TUT1_13: Well, that hurt! Hey, have you noticed the big number? It's your Mojo.
TUT1_14: Your Hero generates Mojo each turn, which is used to play cards and use special abilities.
TUT1_15: Here's a little gift, a Monster Card!
TUT1_16: You will notice this card costs 3 Mojo to cast. (The purple number in the top/left corner of the card).
TUT1_17: Tap down and drag the card toward your Hero. This will cost 3 Mojo, as displayed on the card.
TUT1_18: Monsters can only be summoned near your Hero.
TUT1_19: Freshly summoned Monsters are Exhausted. They can attack but not move. End the turn to continue.
TUT1_20: This Monster is a Warrior. Warriors are generally tough, but only have a range of 1.
TUT1_21: Warriors can also choose to move a second time instead of attacking. Neat!
TUT1_22: Have a go at attacking me with your new forces.
TUT1_23: Here, let me give you a new toy.
TUT1_24: Take this new Equipment Card. It's a Dagger; Warriors can use these.
TUT1_25: Conveniently your Hero is also a Warrior. It's like I thought this through!
TUT1_26: Drag the dagger onto one of your creatures to give it to them.
TUT1_27: Warriors can use all melee weapons. Archers use Bows, and Mages use Staves.
TUT1_28:
Use your new bling to defeat the Enemy Hero. Yeah, I used a colloquialism. I'm cool like that.

// Tutorial 2
TUT2_1: You did so well in the last Tutorial that I gave you a new card. Isn't it pretty?
TUT2_2: There are hundreds of cards in this game, so you'll have to choose wisely when building your deck.
TUT2_3: But I'm getting ahead of myself. Check out your new card; a Mage!
TUT2_4: Mages can attack enemies that are two tiles away. Summon this Mage to continue.
TUT2_5: End the turn so we can replenish our Mojo. Trust me, we're going to need it!
TUT2_6: Some Monsters have special Abilities. Select your Mage to see his Ability.
TUT2_7: This mage has Fireball. It costs 2 Mojo to cast, but is quite powerful. Select it now.
TUT2_8: To fire it, you must be in range. Give it a go and then end the turn.
TUT2_9: Hah! Eat that. Not so smart now, are you?
TUT2_10: I guess this is a bit one-sided. Here, have an Archer.
TUT2_11: Archers are sneaky. They can attack enemies that are three tiles away!
TUT2_12: On the downside, they can't hit things that are right in front of them.
TUT2_13:
Now try to defeat me!

// Tutorial 3
TUT3_1: Are you ready for a proper fight?
TUT3_2: Check out this new card. Runes have passive effects and must be placed on Rune stands.
TUT3_3: You only have a limited number of Rune stands based on the map you're playing, so choose wisely.
TUT3_4: Select your new Rune to continue.
TUT3_5: This Rune grants you additional Mojo each turn. Drag it onto a Rune Stand to activate it.
TUT3_6: Now you will generate extra Mojo each turn. Check it out by ending the turn.
TUT3_7: See? Now you're getting 5 Mojo each turn. That's very useful.
TUT3_8: Did you notice this card? It's a spell. Select it now.
TUT3_9: This Spell gives you Mojo for each Rune you own. Drag it anywhere onto the field to activate it.
TUT3_10: Of course that spell costs 3 to cast and you only had one Rune, so it's more effective if you have more Runes.
TUT3_11: Levels will often have bonus tiles on the ground. Let's put a Monster on this Defence Tile.
TUT3_12: The Monster now has 2 Defence, but only while it's standing on the bonus tile.
TUT3_13: Defence is like Health but it replenishes every turn like Mojo, making it very useful.
TUT3_14: You can also use Equipment cards like Shields to gain Defence. There are even some Runes that can do it.
TUT3_15: This is a Power Tile. Anything that stands on it gets +2 Power.
TUT3_16: And this is a super-important Mojo tile. You earn +2 Mojo each turn for each Mojo tile you're standing on.
TUT3_17: That's it. You're ready for the big leagues now! Defeat me to complete this tutorial.
